ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud and abuse, including the recent case of four men who pleaded guilty in a $2.2M Medicaid housing fraud scheme in Minnesota.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud and abuse?
How can we prevent Medicaid fraud and abuse in the future?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to expose a larger pattern of corruption and abuse in the Medicaid system. By following the money and investigating the scope of Medicaid fraud and abuse, we can shed light on the issue and prompt meaningful reform.

ideas.title: The Cyclospora Outbreak: A Food Safety Crisis
ideas.description: This story would investigate the largest known U.S. cyclospora outbreak, including the handling of the outbreak by federal authorities and the impact on food safety.
questions: What is the cause of the cyclospora outbreak?
How can we prevent similar outbreaks in the future?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to expose a larger pattern of neglect and incompetence in the handling of food safety crises. By investigating the cyclospora outbreak and its impact on food safety, we can shed light on the issue and prompt meaningful reform.
